caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers set against a plain, light-colored background. The chest is primarily brown with varying shades suggesting wood grain texture throughout its surfaces. The top section of the chest has a decorative, arched crest featuring scroll-shaped elements on each side and a central curved peak. Below the crest, there are three small drawers aligned horizontally, with the center drawer featuring a carved fan-shaped motif. Underneath these, there are four larger drawers stacked vertically. The bottom section consists of three additional drawers, with the center one again featuring a fan-shaped carved detail. All drawers have bright yellow metal handles and keyhole plates. The chest stands on four tall, curved cabriole legs. The artist's signature, "D. S. DeVault," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Highboy
